# Vendored iWork test fixtures

These real, Apple-app-produced iWork files are used only as read-only test
fixtures to validate the container codec and readers against genuine data.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `simple-oneslide.key`, `simple-oneslide.iwa`, `multi-chunk.iwa` | [psobot/keynote-parser](https://github.com/psobot/keynote-parser) `tests/data` | MIT (© Peter Sobot) |
| `test-1.numbers` | [masaccio/numbers-parser](https://github.com/masaccio/numbers-parser) `tests/data` | MIT (© Jon Connell) |

Both upstream projects are MIT-licensed; these fixtures are redistributed here
under that license for testing purposes only.
